body.statement: Given a finite universe, a finite family of its subsets, and an integer \(k\), the optimization problem of selecting at most \(k\) subsets to maximize the cardinality of their union is NP-hard.

source.locator: Section 1, computational-complexity discussion of maximum coverage
source.verbatim_statement: so too is the problem of covering a maximum set of elements with a fixed number of subsets.

attestation.note: Verified against the authors' Berkeley-hosted copy of Hochbaum and Pathria (1998), Introduction, printed page 616: https://hochbaum.ieor.berkeley.edu/html/pub/HPathria-max-k-coverage-greedy.pdf.
